discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed in 7427f033 — but with a different approach than suggested. Skills derive canonicalId exclusively from the directory name (source of truth). The code now warns if a skill manifest contains a `canonicalId` field (it should not) and always uses `path.basename(dir)`. Tests updated to match.
Fixed in 9e42a75e — normalized IDE keys to lowercase at assignment time so all downstream lookups are consistent.
